title: Report: Kendrick Bourne has a fractured tibia, will miss the rest of the season

sources.name: Yahoo Sports NFL
sources.title: Report: Kendrick Bourne has a fractured tibia, will miss the rest of the season
sources.description: Cardinals head coach Mike LaFleur said at his Monday press conference that wide receiver Kendrick Bourne could miss the rest of the season with a leg injury he suffered in Sunday's overtime win over the Cowboys and a report on Monday evening says that will be the case.
